delivery_target: Any caller of complete_signal_invs that does not independently hold tcb_at tcb can switch to this variant; handle_recv and receive_ipc proofs are likely consumers
new_lemma:
lemma complete_signal_invs_no_tcb_at:
  "\\<lbrace>invs\\<rbrace>
     complete_signal ntfnptr tcb
   \\<lbrace>\\<lambda>_. invs\\<rbrace>"
  by (wpsimp simp: complete_signal_def invs_def valid_state_def valid_pspace_def
            wp: get_simple_ko_wp set_simple_ko_valid_objs set_simple_ko_refs_of
                hoare_vcg_all_lift valid_irq_node_typ set_ntfn_minor_invs)
rationale: High-priority hint (differential signal: invs IS consumed, tcb_at is not). complete_signal reads and updates the notification object; tcb_at is never structurally required because any assertion on a missing TCB makes the triple vacuously true on the failure path. Dropping tcb_at gives a strictly stronger precondition.
